title: 多模块聚合：reactor 构建顺序与循环依赖检测
expected_output:
=== declared <modules> order ===
  [common, dao, service, web, gateway]

=== intra-reactor dependencies (module -> what it needs) ===
  dao -> [common]
  service -> [dao, common]
  web -> [service]
  gateway -> [common]

=== reactor build order (dependencies first) ===
  1. common
  2. dao
  3. gateway
  4. service
  5. web
  modules built = 5 / 5
  note: 'gateway' jumped ahead of 'service'/'web' because it only needs 'common'

=== now add a cycle: common -> web ===
  dao -> [common]
  service -> [dao, common]
  web -> [service]
  gateway -> [common]
  common -> [web]
  modules built = 0 / 5
  reason: every module has at least one unfinished dependency
  maven would fail with: the projects in the reactor contain a cyclic reference
